scripts.dev: bash scripts/ensure-supabase.sh && concurrently -n api,web,mcp -c green,magenta,cyan "cd api && bin/cake server -p 8765" "cd web && bun run dev" "cd mcp && bun run dev"
scripts.deploy: kamal deploy -c config/deploy.api.yml && ( cd web && bun run build ) && kamal deploy -c config/deploy.web.yml
scripts.deploy:web: ( cd web && bun run build ) && kamal deploy -c config/deploy.web.yml
scripts.migrate:prod: cd api && test -n "$(grep -E '^DATABASE_URL_PROD=' .env | cut -d= -f2-)" && ! grep -qiE '^DATABASE_URL_PROD=.*(localhost|127[.]0[.]0[.]1)' .env && bin/cake migrations migrate --connection prod
